concept: Predict one unordered Top3 set among 35 triples, normalize the set posterior, and marginalize it into rider Top3-membership. Compare A=Top3 membership, B=Top3-Top2 boundary, and C=calibration-only learned Top3-beta*Top2.

top3_model.selection_rule: 0.55 * worst development-fold score + 0.45 * mean development-fold score
top3_model.dependency_guard: The Top3 classifier receives neither v21 nor v31 outputs. v31 enters only after Top3 inference in B/C, so v32 can rescue a v21/v31 miss and 2024 training cannot receive later v31 labels.
